final_interpretation.action: Positive alcohol test (≥ 0.04). DOT violation. Remove from safety-sensitive duties immediately. SAP evaluation required. Report to FMCSA Clearinghouse if applicable.
final_interpretation.employer_action: Immediate removal, SAP referral, document violation.
final_interpretation.clearinghouse: Report to FMCSA Clearinghouse within 3 business days if FMCSA-regulated.

procedure_steps.name: Verify EBT Device
procedure_steps.instruction: Confirm device is an Evidentiary Breath Testing (EBT) device on the NHTSA Conforming Products List (CPL). Record make, model, and serial number on ATF.
procedure_steps.fatal_note: EBT not on CPL = invalid test

procedure_steps.name: Air Blank
procedure_steps.instruction: Perform air blank per device instructions. Air blank MUST read 0.00 before screening test. If not 0.00, do not proceed — device error.

procedure_steps.name: Verify Donor Identity
procedure_steps.instruction: Government-issued photo ID. Confirm name matches testing authorization. Record ID type on ATF.

procedure_steps.name: Explain Procedure
procedure_steps.instruction: Explain screening test, possibility of 15-minute wait and confirmation test if screening is ≥ 0.02. Explain consequences of refusal.

procedure_steps.name: 15-Minute Abstention (Before Screening)
procedure_steps.instruction: Donor must not eat, drink, smoke, use mouthwash, or put anything in mouth for 15 minutes before screening blow. Start timer. Observe or document start time.

procedure_steps.name: Screening Test (EBT)
procedure_steps.instruction: Donor provides breath sample per device instructions. BAT operates EBT. Result MUST print from EBT. Attach printed result to ATF.
procedure_steps.fatal_note: EBT fails to print result = CANCEL TEST

procedure_steps.name: Evaluate Screening Result
procedure_steps.instruction: If BrAC < 0.02: NEGATIVE — test complete, go to Step 12 (documentation). If BrAC ≥ 0.02: proceed to Step 8 (15-minute wait — NOT optional).

procedure_steps.name: 15-Minute Wait (Screen Positive Only)
procedure_steps.instruction: Minimum 15 minutes between end of screening blow and start of confirmation blow. Maximum 30 minutes recommended. Donor must NOT eat, drink, smoke, or put anything in mouth. If donor violates abstention during wait, document on ATF.
procedure_steps.fatal_note: Less than 15 minutes between screening and confirmation = FATAL FLAW

procedure_steps.name: Air Blank Before Confirmation
procedure_steps.instruction: Repeat air blank. Must read 0.00 before confirmation test.

procedure_steps.name: Confirmation Test (EBT Only)
procedure_steps.instruction: Second test MUST be on EBT — not an alcohol screening device (ASD). Donor blows. Print result. Attach to ATF.
procedure_steps.fatal_note: Confirmation on ASD instead of EBT = CANCEL TEST

procedure_steps.name: Evaluate Confirmation Result
procedure_steps.instruction: Apply confirmation interpretation: <0.02 negative; 0.02–0.039 positive (low); ≥0.04 positive (violation). Document all BrAC values on ATF.

procedure_steps.name: ATF Completion & Signatures
procedure_steps.instruction: BAT signs ATF. Employee signs ATF (or document refusal to sign). All printed EBT results attached. Copy to employer/DER as required.
procedure_steps.fatal_note: No BAT signature or no employee signature (uncorrected) = FATAL

screening_interp.action: Screening ≥ 0.02. MUST wait minimum 15 minutes before confirmation test on EBT. Donor must not eat, drink, smoke, or put anything in mouth during wait.
